images.title: A square cut by its diagonals, two colours
images.purpose: Show the worked example: a square cut by its two diagonals into 4 triangles, the top and bottom orange and the left and right blue, with its vertical and horizontal lines of symmetry dashed.
images.composition: One large square in the middle with its two diagonals, two orange triangles and two blue triangles, and two dashed lines through the middle.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One large square, 420 by 420 px, centred in the frame (x 518 to 938, y 190 to 610), with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (4 px). Its two diagonals are drawn as thin dark lines (3 px) from corner to corner, cutting the square into exactly 4 triangles that meet at the centre (728, 400). The TOP triangle and the BOTTOM triangle are filled amber #E69F00. The LEFT triangle and the RIGHT triangle are filled teal #0072B2. Two dashed lines in grey #6B7280 (5 px dashes): one vertical through the centre from y 160 to y 640 at x 728, one horizontal through the centre from x 488 to x 968 at y 400. At the top end of the vertical dashed line, centred at x 728 and y 135, the label Vertical line; at the right end of the horizontal dashed line, starting at x 985 and centred on y 400, the label Horizontal line, both in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (36 px). Exactly 1 square, 4 triangles and 2 dashed lines. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a dashed line along a diagonal
any other colour than amber and teal
images.takeaway: Colours count: after a 1/2 turn this design looks the same, after a 1/4 turn it does not, and it has two lines of symmetry.
images.description: A square cut by its diagonals into 4 triangles, top and bottom amber, left and right teal, with a dashed vertical line and a dashed horizontal line through the middle.
images.context: Concept image for the second teaching concept, Turn Symmetry and Reflection Symmetry in a Design. It uses the plan's own two-colour square (a practice value).
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to turn the square a 1/2 turn and then a 1/4 turn in their mind and watch the colours. The slip to watch: checking the shape and forgetting the colours.

image_decisions.why: The two-colour square with its dashed lines makes the worked example visible: the colours decide the turns and the lines.
